## Q. I want it to trigger for members only

![](../../../../images/21_LimitEdit-1792763868318.webp)

1. In OmikujiBot Editor, open Comment Events > Trigger Settings.
2. Under "Trigger Condition to Apply", select "User Role".
3. Choose according to the users you want to apply it to.
   - "Paid Member" refers to the membership feature of the following services.
     - YouTube: Members
     - Twitch: Subscribers
     - Niconico Live: Premium members (not followers)
   - It may also work with other services that have a membership feature (sorry, this has not been verified).
